upper_bound.witness: Missing: a proof that the overlay of collections A and B (with total lengths p >= q) can be realized with at most |A|+|B|-1 new cuts, i.e. an actual count of which division points of one row must be cut in the other (including the cut at position q, and the coincidences with existing endpoints). The quoted sentence only names the construction and explicitly defers the count as 'standard; details omitted', so the bound (5) is asserted, not proved.
upper_bound.load_bearing: The final cut budget in Section 5 is (|A|+|B|-1)+(n+1-|A|-|B|)=n, which is exactly the constraint that Xiang Yu may use at most n marks; without the deferred count, the claimed Xiang reply is not shown to be legal.
